question: If x² + y² + z² + 26 = 2(4x + y + 3z), then find the value of x + y + z.
solution:
Given:

x2 + y2 + z2 + 26 = 2(4x + y + 3z)

Concept used:

(A - B)² = A² - 2AB + B²

If A² + B² + C² = 0 then A = B = C = 0 i.e., A + B + C = 0

Calculation:

x2 + y2 + z2 + 26 = 2(4x + y + 3z)

⇒ x2 + y2 + z2 + 26 = 8x + 2y + 6z

⇒ (x2 - 8x + 16) + (y2 - 2y + 1) + (z2 - 6z + 9) = 0

⇒ (x - 4)² + (y - 1)² + (z - 3)² = 0

According to the concept,

Now, (x - 4) + (y - 1) + (z - 3) = 0

⇒ x + y + z = 4 + 1 + 3

⇒ x + y + z = 8

**∴ The value of x + y + z is 8.**
